description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/domain/ssl (base $0.005; USDC on Base or Polygon); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?domain=example.com (one hostname per call). TLS certificate for one public hostname, read from a direct handshake on port 443: issuer, subject, SANs, valid from/to, days remaining, expired, hostname match, chain length. No HTTP request is sent. One name per call. USDC on Base or Polygon. On USDC on Base, errors are not charged, apart from the exceptions noted on a route. On USDC on Solana, and RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, a refused or failed request may still be charged. On Polygon (native USDC), a request is settled only when it succeeds (HTTP status below 400). Failed requests are not charged.
name: domain_ssl_quote
title: SSL Certificate Expiry Payment Quote
